# ghost/linux-command-library

Linux Command Library (F-Droid): an offline reference of thousands of Linux commands. Search a command, open its page and read the TLDR examples, synopsis, description and parameters. No account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/linux-command-library
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/linux-command-library open_library --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/linux-command-library search_commands --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/linux-command-library open_command --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/linux-command-library read_section --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/linux-command-library get_state --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_library`: Open the Linux command library
- `search_commands`: Search the Linux command library for tar
- `open_command`: Open the tar command page
- `read_section`: Read the TLDR examples of the open command
- `get_state`: What is the Linux command library showing?
